name: context-menu
title: Context Menu 右键菜单
description: 在区域内右键（触屏长按）打开的操作菜单。

whenToUse: 为文件、列表项、画布元素等区域提供右键快捷操作
需要复选项、单选项或子菜单的上下文操作

whenNotToUse.case: 页面上唯一的操作入口（右键难以被发现）
桌面应用顶部常驻的命令菜单

accessibility: 触发区域聚焦后支持 Shift+F10 和菜单键，菜单内支持方向键、回车、Esc 和子菜单导航
同样的操作应在可见的按钮或菜单中也能完成；Shortcut 只是快捷键提示，快捷键需另行实现
responsive: 触屏通过长按打开，用户不易发现，移动端要提供可见入口
菜单靠近边缘时自动调整位置保持在视口内

# Context Menu 设计规范

- 默认外观参考 Linear 问题列表的右键菜单。实色面板圆角 12 px，选项高至少 32 px，行内圆角 8 px，图文间距 8 px。普通操作起止留白 8／12 px，选择行给行尾勾选预留 32 px。键盘高亮留在选项内部。面板与子菜单使用同一浅深配色。

- 右键（触屏为长按）菜单不容易被发现：菜单里的每个操作都必须在界面其他地方也能完成，如工具栏按钮或 Dropdown Menu。
- `ContextMenu.Trigger` 包住响应右键的区域。需要将普通容器加入键盘顺序时，添加 `tabindex={0}` 和可访问名称。聚焦后可按 Shift+F10 或菜单键，Escape 关闭并归焦。
- 操作用 `onSelect`，复选和单选分别用 `CheckboxItem` 和 `RadioItem`。行尾的 `ContextMenu.Shortcut` 仅提示快捷键。确认流程可以由中性色菜单项打开，确认按钮再使用危险色。
- 父菜单与子菜单根据锚点和可用空间定位，内容过长时在各自的菜单内滚动。
- 可搜索的子面板用 `SubTrigger aria-haspopup="dialog"` 和具名的 `SubContent role="dialog"`，内部放 Command 输入与选项列表。打开时聚焦输入，确认后关闭主菜单，Escape 返回子菜单入口。
- 不要用它替代浏览器在输入框、链接上的原生右键菜单。

<script lang="ts">
	import { ContextMenu as ContextMenuPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { innerWidth } from "svelte/reactivity/window";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { WithoutChildrenOrChild } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import ContextMenuPortal from "./context-menu-portal.svelte";
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		portalProps,
		class: className,
		side,
		...restProps
	}: ContextMenuPrimitive.ContentProps & {
		portalProps?: WithoutChildrenOrChild<ComponentProps<typeof ContextMenuPortal>>;
	} = $props();

	const preferredSide = $derived(
		side ?? ((innerWidth.current ?? Infinity) < 400 ? "bottom" : "right")
	);
</script>

<ContextMenuPortal {...portalProps}>
	<ContextMenuPrimitive.Content
		bind:ref
		data-slot="context-menu-content"
		side={preferredSide}
		class={cn(
			"data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 min-w-[min(var(--valar-context-menu-min-width,180px),var(--bits-floating-available-width,100vw),calc(100vw-1rem))] rounded-[12px] p-1.5 duration-0 motion-reduce:animate-none! cn-menu-target border-[0.5px] border-[lch(91.9%_0_282)] bg-[color:var(--valar-overlay-background,white)] text-[color:var(--valar-overlay-foreground,lch(20%_1_282))] shadow-[var(--valar-overlay-shadow,0_3px_8px_#00000020,0_2px_5px_#00000020,0_1px_1px_#00000020)] dark:border-[lch(25.68%_1.93_272)] dark:bg-[color:var(--valar-overlay-background,lch(12.72%_0.85_272))] dark:text-[color:var(--valar-overlay-foreground,lch(91.178%_1.425_272))] [--valar-context-menu-highlight:lch(95%_0_282)] [--valar-context-menu-highlight-text:lch(10%_0_282)] [--valar-overlay-shadow:0_6px_18px_rgb(0_0_0/.02),0_3px_9px_rgb(0_0_0/.04),0_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.04)] dark:[--valar-context-menu-highlight:lch(20.82%_1.3_272)] dark:[--valar-context-menu-highlight-text:white] dark:[--valar-overlay-shadow:0_3px_8px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_2px_5px_rgb(0_0_0/.125),0_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.125)] z-50 max-h-(--bits-floating-available-height) max-w-[min(var(--bits-floating-available-width,100vw),calc(100vw-1rem))] origin-(--bits-floating-transform-origin) overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain outline-hidden",
			className
		)}
		collisionPadding={8}
		{...restProps}
	/>
</ContextMenuPortal>

	let { open = $bindable(false), ...restProps }: ContextMenuPrimitive.SubProps = $props();

<ContextMenuPrimitive.Sub bind:open {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
	import { ContextMenu as ContextMenuPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		disabled,
		onkeydown,
		...restProps
	}: ContextMenuPrimitive.TriggerProps = $props();

	function handleKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent & { currentTarget: HTMLDivElement }) {
		onkeydown?.(event);
		const opensMenu = event.key === "ContextMenu" || (event.key === "F10" && event.shiftKey);
		if (disabled || event.defaultPrevented || event.target !== event.currentTarget || !opensMenu) {
			return;
		}

		event.preventDefault();
		const target = event.currentTarget;
		const bounds = target.getBoundingClientRect();
		// Bits UI uses the contextmenu event to place the menu at a virtual anchor.
		target.dispatchEvent(
			new MouseEvent("contextmenu", {
				bubbles: true,
				cancelable: true,
				button: 2,
				clientX: bounds.left + Math.min(16, bounds.width / 2),
				clientY: bounds.bottom - Math.min(8, bounds.height / 2),
			})
		);
	}
</script>

<ContextMenuPrimitive.Trigger
	bind:ref
	{disabled}
	data-slot="context-menu-trigger"
	class={cn("select-none", className)}
	{...restProps}
	onkeydown={handleKeydown}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { ContextMenu as ContextMenuPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

	let { open = $bindable(false), ...restProps }: ContextMenuPrimitive.RootProps = $props();
</script>

<ContextMenuPrimitive.Root bind:open {...restProps} />
